action.objective: Verify the reserved candidate f3e5: a knight sortie to e5, checking safety and exact score at depth 4.
action.rationale: Broad depth-2 search suggested f3e5 with exact score 47, PV f3e5 Nc6. However depth 2 is shallow and the bound is exact only at that depth; other candidates like a2a4 were upper-bound (uncertain, possibly worse). f3e5 places the knight actively on e5, attacks d7 bishop and c6, and may support d4 or f7 ideas. I must verify it with the reserved 2000-node budget at effective depth 4 to confirm no immediate tactical refutation (e.g. Bxb5, Nxe5 lines) and get a reliable score before committing.
